title: Human-made music and artist identity
text: Requirements for recordings, artwork and profile photographs.
keywords: Human-made music Fully AI-generated music or masters are not accepted by Artanrecords. Explain who created and performed the work and disclose AI involvement. Tool use is reviewed in context rather than inferred from an audio file alone. Artwork and portraits are different AI-assisted release artwork is not an automatic rejection, but rights, disclosure and delivery requirements still apply. Artist profile images must be genuine photographs of the artist, not generated portraits, synthetic identities or face replacements. Provenance and clarification Human review may request credits, contributor confirmation or relevant session evidence through an agreed private process. Automated scores cannot establish authorship conclusively. No AI detection provider is currently connected. A submission may be paused for clarification rather than rejected on a detector result alone.

title: Referrals, service credits and payments
text: Understand the separate roles of artist introductions, optional services and recording-income payments.
keywords: Artist introductions A referral programme is being prepared for artists who introduce another artist. It is not open for earning or spending credits yet. Acceptance remains a human-reviewed decision; an introduction cannot guarantee an agreement. Credits for agreed services The proposed programme would support approved services such as promotion, artwork and artist websites. Award values, qualifying events, redemption, expiry, cancellations and disputes must be published before activation. No cash conversion or withdrawal is currently available. Referral credits are separate from recording royalties and do not change an artist's revenue share. Optional services and payment methods Accepted standard releases have no upfront base distribution fee. Optional paid services need a separate scope and price agreed before payment. Stripe payment-method management is not connected yet; do not send card numbers, bank details or tax documents through public enquiries. Recording income and withdrawal requests Recording income follows the signed agreement and reconciled reporting. A future withdrawal process must show eligible funds, applicable fees, verification requirements and request status before confirmation. Submitting a request must not be presented as a completed payment. Studio does not currently process withdrawals. Ending a relationship The release agreement must address notice, final accounting, approved expenses, catalogue migration and asset handover. Referral participation and unused service credits require their own programme terms. They must not prevent an artist from exercising rights under the release agreement.

title: Silver, Gold and Platinum partnerships
text: How Silver, Gold and Platinum partnerships work: release preparation, responsibilities, financial terms and agreement review.
keywords: A preference, then a review Silver covers essential release infrastructure. Gold adds a defined release plan and selected presentation support. Platinum adds scoped release leadership and strategic reviews. These are levels of involvement, not rankings of artistic quality. Discuss your preference with Artanrecords; acceptance and scope require a written offer and agreement. Prepare the work Begin with a listening link and a short introduction. Before delivery, prepare finished masters, artwork, titles, credits, contributors and permissions. Keep private masters and identity, tax or banking documents out of the initial enquiry. Record the responsibilities The agreement identifies included services, responsible parties, approvals and timing. Accepted standard releases have no upfront base distribution fee. Additional costs need prior classification as included, artist-paid or recoupable. Paid media, third-party production and domains are not automatically free. Read the financial terms The written offer must define eligible master-side Net Receipts, artist and label shares, permitted deductions, reporting and approved expense treatment. The signed agreement governs, not a partnership name. Publishing and unrelated income remain separate unless expressly contracted. Master ownership remains with the artist under this partnership model. Scope a standalone website Gold eligibility and Platinum priority require a defined website scope. Record domain ownership, registration and renewal funding, hosting, maintenance, content responsibilities and handover. A label catalogue profile is separate from a standalone artist website. Use operational services only when available Private Studio workspaces, agreement access and financial reporting are not operational yet. No online balance, signing or payout service is provided by this guide. Use the agreed direct communication process for current projects. Agree the exit before delivery Record the licence term, notice, final accounting, outstanding expenses, release migration and website handover before onboarding. Preserve identifiers and approved assets; coordinate delivery changes rather than deleting a release first. Continuity of playlists and service statistics is not guaranteed.

title: Start with your music
keywords: A reviewed introduction Artanrecords welcomes artist introductions and creative proposals. The current route is a human-reviewed enquiry, not instant distribution or self-service registration. What to prepare Your artist name, a short introduction and a listening link are enough to begin. Include the release type, contributors and intended timing if known. What follows If there is a fit, the next step is a conversation about scope and terms. Submission alone does not create representation or an artist account.

title: Send your work
text: A practical guide to the current enquiry process.
keywords: Use the label form Open Submit your music on the label website. Choose Music submission, complete the required contact fields and verification, then send. The server response confirms whether the enquiry was saved. Share listening links Use links you have permission to share. Check that the recipient can open them. Do not send masters, identity documents, bank details or tax records through the public form. Correct an enquiry Contact collaborate@artanrecords.com with the enquiry reference where available. Do not repeatedly submit the same enquiry to correct a detail.

title: From enquiry to release
text: Understand the distinction between review and an agreed release.
keywords: Review first An enquiry is reviewed before any release commitment is made. Acceptance, responsibilities and scope must be confirmed separately. Agreement before delivery Rights and commercial terms must be agreed before distribution. There is no automatic delivery from this website to a streaming platform. Prepare and check Artwork, audio, credits and metadata need to be reviewed together. Delivery specifications depend on the agreed distribution arrangement and must be confirmed for each project.

title: Names, credits and identifiers
text: Keep the release record clear and consistent.
keywords: Artist and release names Use the confirmed public artist name consistently. Keep legal identity separate from public credits unless its publication is intended. Confirm the release title, version and track order. Credit the work Provide the contributors and their roles: composition, lyrics, performance, production, mixing, mastering and artwork where applicable. Do not infer credits from an artist name. Existing identifiers Preserve existing ISRC and UPC identifiers when supplied. Do not invent identifiers or assume a reissue needs new ones; confirm the recording history and distributor requirements.

title: Prepare release artwork
text: Artwork guidance before final delivery specifications are agreed.
keywords: Confirm permission Use artwork you have the necessary permission to release. Include the agreed artwork and photography credits. Keep the source Keep the original high-resolution artwork privately. Share a review copy or link for an initial conversation. Confirm delivery requirements Final dimensions, format and export requirements must be confirmed for the chosen delivery arrangement. This guide does not establish a universal distributor specification.

title: Prepare your audio
text: Preserve the master and share safely.
keywords: For initial review A listening link is sufficient. Do not place private master files or production sessions in a public repository. For an accepted release Keep the original lossless master and a clear version history. Confirm the final track order and durations. Before delivery Confirm sample rate, bit depth, channel format and delivery method with the label. No upload portal or automated audio quality-control service is currently available.

title: Find and sign an agreement
text: What is available now, and what must be confirmed before signing.
keywords: No agreement portal yet Studio does not currently store or display signed agreements. No standard artist contract is published or approved here. Request the agreement applicable to your project directly from Artanrecords. Read before signing Review the parties, recordings, rights, term, territory, commercial terms, permitted deductions, reporting, termination and responsibilities. Ask for clarification and obtain independent advice where needed. Digital signature No digital-signature provider is configured. Do not upload a signature or identity document to this website. If an agreement is offered, the label must confirm the approved signing process and verified sender directly. Keep your copy After signing through an agreed process, retain the complete executed document. A website status, checkbox or enquiry acknowledgement is not a signed artist agreement.

title: Royalties and statements
text: Understand the terms before interpreting a balance.
keywords: Your agreement governs There is no universal royalty percentage, deduction policy or payout schedule published here. Those must be defined in an approved agreement. Listening data is not money Streams and audience analytics are different from reported royalties, reconciled receipts and payable amounts. Studio currently displays none of these as real account data. Ask about a statement If you receive a statement, retain its period and reference when raising a question. A secure statement portal is not yet available.

title: Payment and tax information
text: Keep sensitive information out of public enquiries.
keywords: Do not send sensitive details The public form is not a payment or tax onboarding channel. Do not include bank information, tax identifiers or identity documents. After an agreement Any required onboarding must use a separately confirmed secure process. No payout provider or tax onboarding service is configured in Studio. No published payout schedule Payment eligibility, timing and any applicable requirements depend on the approved agreement and accounting process. This guide does not promise a payment date.

title: Using Studio
text: The current artist workspace is a public foundation.
keywords: What you can use You can browse workspace explanations and follow guidance. There are no private accounts, authenticated sessions, artist-specific statistics or stored agreements. What not to enter Do not enter passwords, signatures, private contracts or financial details into a public page. Future operational features require a secure backend and access controls.

title: Public technical foundation
text: How the three public surfaces are built.
keywords: One shared foundation The main label repository owns the shared Artanrecords foundation. Docs and Studio consume committed, checksum-verified snapshots of its approved assets and renderer. Content and rendering Each surface owns its content/site.json. Static HTML, page metadata and sitemap are generated from that collection. CSS controls presentation and JavaScript progressively enhances navigation, theme and documentation search. Build and checks Use Node 22 or later. Run npm run build and npm run check. Shared changes belong in the main repository and are synchronized deliberately; do not patch copied token or icon files. Public only GitHub Pages serves public files. It is not the authorization boundary for private artist data. No private information, credentials, financial records or internal business specification belongs in these repositories.
